answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the jade until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
